Why vendored: the sibling repository is an unpinned checkout at a path that is
not guaranteed to exist on any machine that runs this suite. Copying keeps
tests/test_unit_codex_reducer.py hermetic. Files are byte-for-byte identical to
the source revision.

To refresh:

    cp ../amux/tests/fixtures/codex/*.jsonl     tests/fixtures/codex/
    cp ../amux/tests/fixtures/codex/*.meta.json tests/fixtures/codex/

then update the revision recorded above.

Each <name>.jsonl has a <name>.meta.json sidecar recording the scenario,
argv, exit code, stderr and final-message content of that run. Two fixtures
(exec_truncated_final_line, exec_unknown_event) are marked "synthesized": true.
